title: Ladybug eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M44 36 Q50 41 56 36' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='9' fill='#FFB74D'/>

  <line x1='28' y1='60' x2='18' y2='70' stroke='#B71C1C' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
